lessons.claim: steps_per_second is measured over TOTAL steps, not production steps. Measured: trap-2d-5um recorded wall_seconds=3037.53 and steps_per_second=332.507375, and their product is 1,010,000 = n_eq + n_prod, not n_prod = 1,000,000. Estimating a cost from n_prod alone under-predicts by 0.99% there, and by ~50% for a relaxation case where n_eq ~ n_prod. Use cost.total_steps(n_eq, n_prod). Found 2026-09-02 by a test asserting the estimator reproduces its own archived wall time.
